title: Fact or Guesswork? Evaluating Large Language Models’ Medical Knowledge with Structured One-Hop Judgments

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the accuracy gap between positive and negative binary medical judgment questions to measure the models' inherent inclination to reject rather than accept factual statements.

Correlating model accuracy on various medical entities with the average frequency of those terms in scientific literature (using the PubMed API) to evaluate performance disparities between common and rare medical concepts.
